creates_law_reviewed.class: AUDIT -- this arc audits the corpus's metadata; it proves nothing about the object

claim_one_line: THE creates_law RE-AUDIT (owner-directed, sequenced BEFORE the paper's disposition pass: B1213 fixed the BASE so it no longer depends on the field, but the disposition was about to be filled against a corpus whose law-metadata is 89% missing). THE RULE, fixed before adjudicating: LAW = a NEW GENERAL PROPOSITION PROVED HERE (law, theorem, no-go, exact characterization, uniqueness over a family); NOT LAW = a verification, harvest, audit, census, sealed-cell decision, ledger-write, status or correction, EVEN WITH THEOREM VOCABULARY -- which most of them have, and which is what keeps the registry from the ~600-row flood its designers avoided. RESULT: 13 OF 116. Thirteen genuine laws, EACH READ IN FULL before flipping, now declared and registered -- and the most consequential is B727, THE GENERICITY THEOREM ('E6 across three faces' is forced by ONE ADE classification, so the recurrence is GENERIC NOT EVIDENCE; the sister m003 shares Q(sqrt-3) without being the knot; only the arithmetic atom survives), which was INVISIBLE TO THE REGISTRY and which ANY claim of object-specificity must clear first, INCLUDING THE PAPER'S. With it: B996 (McKay access generic across the metallic family -- the companion negative, computed over GRAMMARS, the right population) and B997 (the golden is the UNIQUE metallic grammar whose own-conductor shadow is a McKay group, PROVED OVER AN INFINITE FAMILY -- the specificity that SURVIVES the genericity, stated positively); plus B991 (hypercharge normalisation not derivable IN PRINCIPLE -- a theorem about the equations, holding for any U(1) in any theory), B952 (the rank obstruction), B885/B886 (two structural laws; the 27 carries exactly six joint Pi-weights), B910/B918 (the one-class theorem and its extension to the value layer), B393, B557, B1070, B1073. THE OTHER 104: absence became a DECISION -- each carries a dated creates_law_reviewed recording why not, classified by kind, moving the field from 'no call ever made' to 'a call, recorded, with its class'. The census moves true 55 -> 68, false 57 -> 137, absent 919 (89%) -> 828 (80%). THE ASYMMETRY IS DECLARED: the 13 that passed were read IN FULL, the 104 that failed were classified from their claim HEADLINES -- a headline states the arc's thesis first, which is a sound basis for a negative call and a poor one for a positive, so the asymmetry runs the safe way. SECOND FINDING: FIVE OF THE THIRTEEN LAWS HAVE NO DEDICATED TEST LOCK (B991/B996/B997 covered only incidentally; B1070 and B1073 have NONE) -- a law-creating arc without a lock is a reproducibility debt, and the registry's lock column now SAYS SO rather than sitting blank, so 'registered and unlocked' is a visible state for five arcs that were previously neither. WHAT THIS DOES NOT CHANGE: the claim base still must not depend on this field -- 828 arcs (80%) remain absent and were deliberately NOT mass-set, which would be the over-declaration flood in reverse; B1213's union criterion stands. The field is now honest where examined and honestly blank where not. Gate 5 clean.
